author: GameTrailers
description: See environments and more from The Castle of the West in this announcement trailer for the upcoming fantasy-themed boomer shooter game. Take down various creatures from Goblins to Skeletons with your rapid-fire crossbow through various hand-crafted non-linear FPS stages. What's not to love? The Castle of the West will be available on PC.
title: The Castle of the West - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Inner City Unit, an upcoming first-person sim about the narcotics trade in the surveillance city-state of Annexia. As an agent of an intelligence outfit, assume the identity of Albert Buchanan - part-time writer, part-time narcotics dealer. Procure product, push it across the city, don't get made. Inner City Unit will be available on PC.
title: Inner City Unit - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Date Trailer for Aeterna Lucis, a 2D action Metroidvania developed by Aeternum Game Studios. Players will embody the Queen of Light to harness new powers, take on larger-than-life bosses, and thwart the plans of a God of Chaos. Aeterna Lucis is launching on December 3 for PC (Steam).
title: Aeterna Lucis - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Video games are more than entertainment. They are a form of artistic expression, shaped by human imagination, experimentation, and collaboration. The Games Without AI Showcase brings together independent developers from around the world who share a commitment to creating games without generative AI.

Discover original universes, distinctive art styles, meaningful stories, and creative gameplay experiences. Beyond the games themselves, this event offers an opportunity to explore the diversity of skills, techniques, and creative decisions involved in making video games.

Our goal is to give visibility to independent studios and celebrate the value of human creativity in the video game industry.

Explore the full selection of games on Steam and support the developers shaping the future of independent gaming.

Steam Event:  https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/46307989/view/705534184444133743 

#IGN #Gaming
title: Games Without AI 2026 | A Showcase of Human-Made Games

author: GameTrailers
description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is available now on PC via Steam. Check out gameplay from Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed in the launch trailer for the adventure game, where you'll adventure across four revamped worlds full of naughty baddies and menacing boss fiights while collecting delicious onions to keep Volvy at extreme levels of awesome.
title: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at gameplay and more from Blacksmith Master in this trailer for the medieval management game. In Blacksmith Master, manage your own medieval smithy and supervise the entire process, from mining ores and gems to designing and selling finished products. Forge everything from weapons and armor to tools and cooking utensils to fund your craft and become the Blacksmith Master. 

Blacksmith Master leaves early access, and version 1.0 is out now on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC.
title: Blacksmith Master - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the GODMODE Beauty Collection Trailer for Dead by Daylight, the hit asymmetrical multiplayer horror game developed by Behaviour Interactive. Players can check out brand-new cosmetics, including Lee Yun-Jin's Glowgetter’s Mission Bow and Élodie Rakoto's Nebula’s Search outfits to survive the night in fashion. The GODMODE Beauty Collection is available now in Dead by Daylight.
title: Dead by Daylight - Official GODMODE Beauty Collection Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the launch trailer for Flick, a first-person body-cam horror game scientifically engineered to spike anticipatory dread. You must toggle light switches throughout a long-abandoned house to instantly shift the environment from a safe reality to a blood-soaked echo where grisly puzzles manifest. But every flick of the switch is a gamble, for within the haunted memories of the house, something from your past has awoken.

Flick is available now on Steam.
title: Flick - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Update 0.7 Launch Trailer for Assetto Corsa Rally, the hit racing simulation game developed by Supernova Games Studios. Players can check out the latest update with a new snow-covered Rally Sweden track, two new cars: the 1986 Lancia Delta S4 & the Lancia Delta S4 Evo, tweaks to physics, and more. Update 0.7 for Assetto Corsa Rally is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Assetto Corsa Rally - Official Update 0.7 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The free multiplayer update for ShipShaper is out now in Steam Early Access. Check out the latest ShipShaper trailer to see what to expect from the multiplayer update, which lets you take your handcrafted vessels into battle and challenge friends.

ShipShaper is a standalone creative shipbuilding sandbox, built around the freedom to design, experiment, and bring incredible ships to life. 

The Multiplayer update brings ShipShaper’s creative shipbuilding and realistic physics together with the chaos of naval battles, allowing players to design their own vessels, put them through their paces and put them to the test against friends.
title: ShipShaper - Multiplayer Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Defender Role Trailer for World of Tanks: HEAT, the hit free-to-play tank-based hero shooter developed by Wargaming Group. Players can get the rundown on the Defender tank class to lock down choke points, make use of the signature ability Kill Zone to damage multiple enemies at once, and defend objectives for the win. Use the Defender Role in World of Tanks: HEAT, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Official Defender Role Trailer

description:
Take another look at the adventure in Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter in this trailer, and see what some critics are saying about this remake of the RPG. Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter is available now on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Global Launch Trailer for GTA 6, the latest entry in the third-person open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto franchise developed by Rockstar Games. Players can get a new look at the highly anticipated title as Jason and Lucia navigate a life of crime with romance in the mix. Explore Vice City and all Leonida has to offer in Grand Theft Auto 6, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #Gaming

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Stay Human!, an upcoming chaotic co-op ambulance simulator set during a zombie apocalypse. Stay Human! will be available on PC.

In Stay Human!, every call is a race through a city crawling with zombies. Your driving can make or break the rescue. Knock zombies out of the way and dodge obstacles. Take a corner too hard? Your teammate doing CPR won't thank you for that. Hit the antidote injector? You might speed up the bitten patient's transformation instead. Your job is to get the patient to the hospital before they become a zombie.
title: Stay Human! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
It's time to go to the theme park. Check out the Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld launch trailer to see chaotic gameplay and more as goats get into mischief in this expansion for the third-person sandbox adventure game. Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox, and PC (Windows, Epic Games Store, and Steam).

Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards.
title: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, a remaster of the arcade action platformer developed by Doinksoft. Players can check out a GTA 6-inspired look at the hit platformer to overcome challenges, take on enemies, and embark on a grand adventure. Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is launching on November 19 for PC (Steam).
title: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed - Official Launch Trailer
